mesha.title: a direct, energetic way of meeting life
mesha.text: With Mesha rising, you tend to meet life head-on, with energy and a readiness to begin. You often act quickly and lead by doing, and new projects bring out your best. Learning to pace yourself lets that natural courage carry you through long efforts as well as fresh starts.

vrishabha.title: a calm, steady approach to life
vrishabha.text: With Vrishabha rising, you tend to approach life calmly and steadily, building comfort and security step by step. You often appreciate good food, music and beautiful surroundings, and people find you reliable. Once you commit to something, your patience and persistence can carry it a long way.

mithuna.title: a curious mind that enjoys connection
mithuna.text: With Mithuna rising, you tend to meet the world through curiosity, conversation and quick thinking. You often enjoy learning several things at once, and words, writing or trade can come naturally. Your adaptability helps you connect with many kinds of people and find your way as situations change.

karka.title: a caring nature rooted in home
karka.text: With Karka rising, you tend to meet life with feeling and care, and home and family matter deeply to you. You often sense what others need before they say it. That sensitivity, paired with a protective instinct, makes you someone people turn to for warmth and support.

simha.title: warmth, dignity and a natural presence
simha.text: With Simha rising, you tend to carry yourself with warmth and dignity, and people often notice your presence. You like to lead, create and be generous with those around you. When you put that confidence behind work you believe in, others are often glad to follow.

kanya.title: a careful, capable and helpful approach
kanya.text: With Kanya rising, you tend to approach life thoughtfully, noticing details others miss. You often enjoy being useful, solving practical problems and improving how things work. Your care, skill and modesty make you a trusted presence at work and at home, and steady study suits you well.

tula.title: grace, fairness and a gift for balance
tula.text: With Tula rising, you tend to seek balance, fairness and harmony in whatever you do. You often have a feel for beauty, good manners and the arts. People value your ability to see both sides, and partnership and cooperation tend to bring out your best qualities.

vrishchika.title: depth, focus and quiet determination
vrishchika.text: With Vrishchika rising, you tend to meet life with depth, focus and quiet determination. You often feel things intensely and keep your own counsel, preferring a few close bonds to many casual ones. Research, investigation and work that rewards persistence can suit you, and your loyalty runs deep.

dhanu.title: an open, optimistic and searching spirit
dhanu.text: With Dhanu rising, you tend to meet life with optimism, honesty and a love of learning. You often look for meaning, whether through study, teaching, travel or faith. Your open-hearted, generous outlook encourages others, and your sense of purpose helps you aim high.

makara.title: patience, responsibility and steady ambition
makara.text: With Makara rising, you tend to approach life practically, with patience and a sense of responsibility. You often build slowly and well, and your efforts tend to grow in value with time. People rely on your steadiness, and long-term goals suit your disciplined, quietly ambitious nature.

kumbha.title: an independent mind with wide concerns
kumbha.text: With Kumbha rising, you tend to think independently and care about people beyond your own circle. You often enjoy ideas, groups and causes that serve the wider community. Your originality and fairness help you see fresh ways of doing things, and friendships tend to matter a great deal.

meena.title: imagination, compassion and a gentle spirit
meena.text: With Meena rising, you tend to meet life with gentleness, imagination and compassion. You often sense moods and atmospheres, and the arts, spiritual life or caring work can draw you. Your kindness and intuition help others feel understood, and quiet time restores your energy.

mesha.title: a quick, spirited and courageous mind
mesha.text: With the Moon in Mesha, your feelings tend to be quick, direct and full of spirit. You often respond to life with enthusiasm and act on your instincts. Your emotional courage helps you start afresh easily, and giving that energy a clear goal keeps your mind settled and content.

vrishabha.title: a warm, steady and contented heart
vrishabha.text: With the Moon in Vrishabha, its sign of exaltation, your feelings tend to be warm, steady and calm. You often find contentment in simple comforts, good food, music and nature. Your emotional steadiness is a quiet strength, and people tend to feel at ease in your company.

mithuna.title: a lively, curious and talkative mind
mithuna.text: With the Moon in Mithuna, your mind tends to be lively, curious and quick to make connections. You often process feelings by talking, reading or writing. Variety keeps you engaged, and your ready wit and interest in people make you easy company and a good communicator.

karka.title: deep feeling and a nurturing heart
karka.text: With the Moon in Karka, its own sign, your feelings tend to run deep and true. You often feel closely tied to home, family and memories, and caring for others comes naturally. Your emotional sensitivity is a real gift, helping you create warmth and belonging wherever you are.

simha.title: a generous, warm and proud heart
simha.text: With the Moon in Simha, your feelings tend to be warm, generous and openly expressed. You often take pride in what you love and enjoy appreciation for your efforts. Your loyalty and big-heartedness lift those around you, and creative or leadership roles can bring you real contentment.

kanya.title: a thoughtful, practical and attentive mind
kanya.text: With the Moon in Kanya, your mind tends to be thoughtful, practical and observant. You often feel settled when things are in order and you can be of real use. Your attention to detail and quiet helpfulness make you dependable, and steady routines tend to keep you calm.

tula.title: a harmonious, sociable and gracious mind
tula.text: With the Moon in Tula, your feelings tend to seek harmony, fairness and good company. You often feel most at ease in pleasant surroundings and balanced relationships. Your tact and grace help smooth over differences, and beauty, music or the arts can be a source of comfort.

vrishchika.title: depth, loyalty and emotional strength
vrishchika.text: With the Moon in Vrishchika, your feelings tend to run deep, and you are loyal to the people and causes you care about. You often sense what lies beneath the surface. That emotional depth gives you resilience, insight into others and a capacity for lasting, wholehearted commitment.

dhanu.title: an optimistic, free and searching mind
dhanu.text: With the Moon in Dhanu, your feelings tend to be open, hopeful and honest. You often feel uplifted by learning, travel, philosophy or faith, and you need room to explore. Your optimism and sense of meaning help you encourage others and see the bigger picture.

makara.title: a steady, sensible and resilient mind
makara.text: With the Moon in Makara, your feelings tend to be steady, reserved and practical. You often find security in work, routine and meeting your responsibilities. Your emotional resilience and patience help you stay calm when things are demanding, and your care shows in what you do for people.

kumbha.title: an independent, humane and original mind
kumbha.text: With the Moon in Kumbha, your mind tends to be independent, original and broad in its concerns. You often care about fairness and the wellbeing of groups and communities. Friendships matter to you, and your calm detachment helps you think clearly when others are carried away by feeling.

meena.title: a gentle, intuitive and compassionate heart
meena.text: With the Moon in Meena, your feelings tend to be gentle, imaginative and deeply sympathetic. You often pick up on the moods of others and respond with kindness. Music, the arts, spiritual life or quiet reflection can nourish you, and your compassion is a real strength.

nakshatra.ashwini: swift help, energy and fresh starts
nakshatra.krittika: sharp clarity and a purifying fire
nakshatra.mrigashira: a searching, curious and gentle mind
nakshatra.ardra: deep thinking and renewal after change
nakshatra.punarvasu: renewal, generosity and a hopeful spirit
nakshatra.ashlesha: keen insight and a perceptive mind
nakshatra.hasta: skilful hands, wit and practical craft
nakshatra.vishakha: purpose, focus and the drive to achieve
nakshatra.jyeshtha: sharp perception and a protective nature
nakshatra.mula: getting to the root of things

1.title: a life led by your own initiative
1.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 1st house, your energy tends to return to yourself and your own path. You often shape your life through personal effort and a clear sense of who you are. Self-reliance comes naturally, and your presence can leave a lasting impression on others.

2.title: a life focused on family and resources
2.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 2nd house, much of your energy tends to go into family, values and building resources carefully. You often have a way with words, and speech can matter in your work. Your sense of what is truly worth keeping guides many of your choices.

3.title: a life shaped by effort and initiative
3.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 3rd house, your focus tends to go into courage, effort and communication. You often make your own opportunities through initiative, writing, short journeys or skilled work with your hands. Siblings, neighbours and close colleagues can play a lively part in your life.

4.title: a life centred on home and roots
4.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 4th house, home, family roots and inner contentment tend to be at the heart of your life. You often find strength in a settled base, property or familiar surroundings. Education and the comfort you create for others can be sources of real satisfaction.

5.title: a life drawn to learning and creativity
5.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 5th house, your energy tends to flow toward learning, creativity and joyful pursuits. You often have good judgment and a gift for teaching or advising. Children, students or creative projects can be among the most rewarding parts of your life.

6.title: a life of service and steady work
6.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 6th house, your focus tends to go into daily work, service and solving practical problems. You often do well in fair competition and enjoy improving routines. This placement asks for diligence and gives you the capacity to handle demanding responsibilities with skill.

7.title: a life lived through partnership
7.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 7th house, much of your energy tends to go toward partnership and the people you work and live alongside. You often grow through cooperation, negotiation and dealing with the public. Your attention to the views of others makes you a thoughtful collaborator.

8.title: a life drawn to depth and research
8.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 8th house, your focus tends to turn toward depth, research and the hidden workings of things. You often adapt well through change and take an interest in shared resources, inheritance or investigation. This placement asks for patience and gives a resourceful, perceptive mind.

9.title: a life guided by learning and principle
9.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 9th house, your life tends to be guided by higher learning, principle and faith. You often benefit from teachers and mentors, and long journeys or study can widen your outlook. Generosity and a sense of purpose come naturally to you.

10.title: a life shaped by work and contribution
10.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 10th house, your energy tends to go into work, reputation and contribution. You often feel most yourself when building something visible and useful. Responsibility suits you, and your efforts in your career can earn steady respect over time.

11.title: a life of gains and wide friendships
11.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 11th house, your focus tends to go toward goals, gains and friendships. You often achieve through networks, groups and the support of people who share your hopes. Your ambitions tend to be well grounded, and steady effort brings them closer.

12.title: a life drawn to retreat and wider horizons
12.text: With the lord of your lagna in the 12th house, your energy tends to turn toward inner life, generosity and lands far away. You often feel at home in quiet places, abroad or in work behind the scenes. Spiritual interests and giving to others can bring you deep satisfaction.

sun.title: a period for confidence and recognition
sun.text: The Sun's mahadasha tends to bring confidence, authority and self-expression into focus. It often suits stepping forward, taking responsibility and earning recognition for your work. Relationships with senior figures and a clearer sense of your own purpose can be central themes of this six-year period.

moon.title: a period for home, feeling and care
moon.text: The Moon's mahadasha tends to bring the mind, feelings, home and family into focus. It often suits nurturing relationships, caring for others and building a settled base. Public-facing work and travel can also feature, and inner contentment becomes an important theme over these ten years.

mars.title: a period for energy and decisive action
mars.text: The mahadasha of Mars tends to bring energy, courage and drive into focus. It often suits taking initiative, competing well, working with property or technical skills, and finishing what you start. These seven years reward decisive action, and channelling your energy toward clear goals brings the best results.

mercury.title: a period for learning and communication
mercury.text: Mercury's mahadasha tends to bring thinking, speech, learning and trade into focus. It often suits study, writing, business, analysis and building useful skills. These seventeen years reward curiosity and clear communication, and connections made through ideas and commerce can open many doors.

jupiter.title: a period for growth and wisdom
jupiter.text: Jupiter's mahadasha tends to bring growth, learning and wisdom into focus. It often suits study, teaching, advising and widening your outlook, and family life and children can be meaningful themes. These sixteen years tend to reward generosity and good judgment with steady progress.

venus.title: a period for comfort, beauty and relationships
venus.text: The mahadasha of Venus tends to bring beauty, comfort, the arts and relationships into focus. It often suits creative work, refining your surroundings and enjoying the good things you have built. These twenty years can bring harmony, pleasant company and appreciation for what you create.

saturn.title: a period for steady building
saturn.text: Saturn's mahadasha tends to bring responsibility, discipline and long-term goals into focus. It often suits patient, careful work, building structures that last and taking on serious commitments. Over these nineteen years, steady effort tends to bring solid, lasting results that grow in value.

rahu.title: a period for ambition and new horizons
rahu.text: Rahu's mahadasha tends to amplify ambition, curiosity and the wish to explore. It often brings unfamiliar fields, new technology, travel or people from other cultures into your life. Over these eighteen years, staying grounded in your values helps you turn big ambitions into lasting achievement.

ketu.title: a period for reflection and inner growth
ketu.text: Ketu's mahadasha tends to turn your attention inward, toward insight, simplicity and spiritual life. It often suits research, specialised study and letting go of what no longer matters. These seven years can bring clarity about your true priorities and a deeper sense of inner freedom.

antar.sun: With the Sun's sub-period, confidence, leadership and recognition for your work come into focus.
antar.moon: With the Moon's sub-period, family, emotional connections and caring for others come into focus.
antar.mars: With Mars's sub-period, energy, initiative and decisive action come into focus.
antar.mercury: With Mercury's sub-period, learning, communication, business and new skills come into focus.
antar.jupiter: With Jupiter's sub-period, growth, study, guidance from teachers and generosity come into focus.
antar.venus: With Venus's sub-period, comfort, creativity, the arts and close relationships come into focus.
antar.saturn: With Saturn's sub-period, steady effort, responsibility and long-term planning come into focus.
antar.rahu: With Rahu's sub-period, ambition, curiosity and unfamiliar opportunities come into focus.
antar.ketu: With Ketu's sub-period, reflection, inner life and simplifying what matters come into focus.

sun.title: Sun: confidence you can lean on
sun.text: With the Sun as the strongest graha in your chart, confidence and a clear sense of purpose are qualities you can rely on. You often take responsibility naturally and lead with integrity. When decisions are needed, trusting your own judgment tends to serve you well.

moon.title: Moon: emotional steadiness you can lean on
moon.text: With the Moon as the strongest graha in your chart, your mind and feelings are a source of strength. You often read people well, adapt with ease and offer real care. Trusting your instincts and nurturing your close bonds tends to bring out your best.

mars.title: Mars: courage you can lean on
mars.text: With Mars as the strongest graha in your chart, courage, energy and drive are qualities you can rely on. You often act decisively and keep going when others slow down. Practical skill, initiative and the determination to finish what you start tend to carry you far.

mercury.title: Mercury: a quick mind you can lean on
mercury.text: With Mercury as the strongest graha in your chart, clear thinking and communication are qualities you can rely on. You often learn quickly, explain things well and spot practical solutions. Writing, analysis, trade or teaching can make good use of this sharp, adaptable mind.

jupiter.title: Jupiter: wisdom you can lean on
jupiter.text: With Jupiter as the strongest graha in your chart, wisdom, good judgment and generosity are qualities you can rely on. You often grow through learning and enjoy guiding others. People tend to trust your advice, and your optimism helps you see the way forward.

venus.title: Venus: grace you can lean on
venus.text: With Venus as the strongest graha in your chart, grace, charm and an eye for beauty are qualities you can rely on. You often bring harmony to people and places, and the arts or design can come naturally. Your warmth makes cooperation and friendship easier.

saturn.title: Saturn: patience you can lean on
saturn.text: With Saturn as the strongest graha in your chart, patience, discipline and persistence are qualities you can rely on. You often build slowly and carefully, and what you build tends to last. Your sense of responsibility earns steady trust from others over time.

rahu.title: Rahu: ambition you can lean on
rahu.text: With Rahu as the strongest graha in your chart, ambition, curiosity and an appetite for exploring are qualities you can rely on. You often thrive in new fields and unfamiliar settings. Your openness to innovation helps you see opportunities that others overlook.

ketu.title: Ketu: insight you can lean on
ketu.text: With Ketu as the strongest graha in your chart, insight, focus and inner calm are qualities you can rely on. You often see to the heart of things and need little outside approval. Research, specialised skills and spiritual interests can make good use of this gift.

gajakesari.title: wisdom, respect and a good name
gajakesari.text: This yoga forms when Jupiter is in a kendra from the Moon. It is traditionally linked with wisdom, a generous nature and the respect of others, and it can help you stay steady and clear-minded.

budhaditya.title: intelligence and clear expression
budhaditya.text: This yoga forms when the Sun and Mercury sit together. It is traditionally linked with intelligence, clear speech and skill in learning, and it suits work that calls for both confidence and a sharp mind.

chandra-mangala.title: enterprise and resourcefulness
chandra-mangala.text: This yoga forms when the Moon and Mars sit together. It is traditionally linked with enterprise, initiative and resourcefulness in earning, along with the emotional courage to act on your plans.

sunapha.title: self-made resources and capability
sunapha.text: This yoga forms when a graha other than the Sun occupies the 2nd house from the Moon. It is traditionally linked with self-earned resources, intelligence and a good name built through your own effort.

anapha.title: poise, good manners and self-reliance
anapha.text: This yoga forms when a graha other than the Sun occupies the 12th house from the Moon. It is traditionally linked with a pleasant manner, self-assurance and the ease that comes from inner contentment.

durudhara.title: support and comfort on all sides
durudhara.text: This yoga forms when grahas other than the Sun occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Moon. It is traditionally linked with generosity, comfort and support from many directions.

vesi.title: steady effort and a balanced outlook
vesi.text: This yoga forms when a graha other than the Moon occupies the 2nd house from the Sun. It is traditionally linked with truthfulness, steady effort and a balanced outlook.

vasi.title: skill and generosity
vasi.text: This yoga forms when a graha other than the Moon occupies the 12th house from the Sun. It is traditionally linked with skill, generosity and recognition earned through capable work.

ubhayachari.title: eloquence and a respected standing
ubhayachari.text: This yoga forms when grahas other than the Moon occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Sun. It is traditionally linked with eloquence, balanced judgment and a well-respected standing.

amala.title: a spotless reputation
amala.text: This yoga forms when a natural benefic occupies the 10th house from the lagna or the Moon. It is traditionally linked with a good reputation, ethical conduct and lasting respect for your work.

parivartana.title: mutual support between houses
parivartana.text: This yoga forms when two grahas occupy each other's signs. It is traditionally said to link the areas of life those houses govern, so that each supports and strengthens the other.

ruchaka.title: courage and leadership
ruchaka.text: One of the five Mahapurusha yogas, it forms when Mars is in its own or exalted sign in a kendra. It is traditionally linked with courage, energy, leadership and a decisive spirit.

bhadra.title: intellect and eloquence
bhadra.text: One of the five Mahapurusha yogas, it forms when Mercury is in its own or exalted sign in a kendra. It is traditionally linked with intelligence, eloquence, skill in trade and a quick, learned mind.

hamsa.title: wisdom and goodness
hamsa.text: One of the five Mahapurusha yogas, it forms when Jupiter is in its own or exalted sign in a kendra. It is traditionally linked with wisdom, a principled nature, the respect of others and a love of learning.

malavya.title: grace, comfort and refinement
malavya.text: One of the five Mahapurusha yogas, it forms when Venus is in its own or exalted sign in a kendra. It is traditionally linked with charm, artistic taste, comfort and a refined enjoyment of life.

sasa.title: authority and perseverance
sasa.text: One of the five Mahapurusha yogas, it forms when Saturn is in its own or exalted sign in a kendra. It is traditionally linked with discipline, perseverance, organising ability and authority earned through steady work.

1.title: a steady, self-directed presence
1.text: You tend to meet the world with confidence and a clear sense of who you are. People often look to you to take the lead, and you are at your best when your work carries your own name. Honest pride in your efforts suits you better than seeking approval.

2.title: a voice that carries weight
2.text: Your words tend to carry authority, and family values and traditions often matter a great deal to you. Money is usually handled with dignity and responsibility rather than for show. Speaking with warmth as well as firmness helps your views land well with others.

3.title: courage to speak and act
3.text: You tend to take initiative readily, whether in writing, short journeys, media or your own ventures. Siblings and neighbours often see you as a steady, independent figure. Your efforts grow through persistence, and you are comfortable making the first move when others hesitate.
3.why: The 3rd is an upachaya house, where the Sun is traditionally said to give results that grow with effort and time.

4.title: a home you take pride in
4.text: Home, land and a settled base matter deeply to you, and you often take on responsibility for the household. A parent's example can shape your values strongly. Your inner contentment tends to grow when you have a space that is truly your own to run.

5.title: bright ideas and a creative spark
5.text: Intelligence, creative work and leadership in study come naturally to you. You often enjoy guiding younger people and take real pride in what they achieve. Planning, strategy and thoughtful investments suit you, as does any field where an original idea can be put forward with confidence.

6.title: steady in service and competition
6.text: You tend to rise to the occasion when there is work to be done, a problem to solve or a competitor to meet. Daily routines and disciplined service suit you, and colleagues often rely on you. Administration, public service and law can draw out your best.
6.why: The 6th is an upachaya house, and the Sun here is classically praised for prevailing over rivals.

7.title: partnerships with a clear voice
7.text: You tend to bring confidence and a sense of purpose into partnerships, in business and in personal life. You often admire people who carry themselves with dignity. Giving a partner room to lead at times helps your relationships grow, and public dealings and negotiations often suit you.

8.title: depth, research and quiet resilience
8.text: You are drawn to what lies beneath the surface: research, investigation, hidden knowledge and the workings of shared resources. Periods of change tend to strengthen your sense of self. Work with inheritance, insurance, joint finances or deep study often suits your patient, probing mind.

9.title: guided by principle and learning
9.text: Higher learning, philosophy and a strong moral compass tend to guide your choices. Teachers, mentors and a parent often play an important part in shaping your outlook. You can find meaning in long journeys, pilgrimage and roles where you uphold fairness and tradition.

10.title: a natural place in public life
10.text: Career, reputation and responsibility tend to come into focus early, and you often thrive in roles of authority. Government, management and leadership positions suit you. Your work tends to be noticed, and you carry public duties with a strong sense of purpose.
10.why: The Sun gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 10th, one of its finest placements.

11.title: goals reached through good connections
11.text: Friendships with capable, established people often support your ambitions. You tend to set clear goals and reach them steadily, with gains coming through your own standing and effort. Elder siblings and wider networks can be a source of encouragement, and you are often trusted to lead groups.
11.why: The 11th is an upachaya house of growth, where the Sun is classically said to give steady gains over time.

12.title: quiet service behind the scenes
12.text: You often do your best work away from the spotlight, in research, charitable work, institutions or behind the scenes. Foreign lands and travel can open meaningful opportunities. Time for retreat, reflection and spiritual practice tends to restore your sense of purpose and inner clarity.

1.title: a warm, responsive nature
1.text: You tend to be sensitive to moods and atmospheres, and people often find you approachable and caring. Your outlook can shift with circumstances, which makes you adaptable and quick to connect. Nurturing others, public-facing work and creative expression often come easily to you.
1.why: The Moon in the lagna, a kendra, is traditionally said to give a pleasant, sociable presence.

2.title: a gentle voice and family warmth
2.text: Your speech tends to be kind and persuasive, and family gatherings, good food and shared traditions mean a lot to you. Resources often grow through steady, careful handling. You can be a natural storyteller, singer or teacher, with a voice that puts others at ease.

3.title: a curious, expressive mind
3.text: You tend to communicate with feeling, whether through writing, music, media or conversation. Short trips, new ideas and contact with siblings and neighbours keep you lively. Your courage often grows with experience, and you enjoy projects that let your imagination take a practical shape.

4.title: a heart rooted in home
4.text: Home, a parent's care and a settled environment tend to be central to your contentment. You often create a welcoming space where others feel at ease. Property, gardening and education can bring satisfaction, and your emotional steadiness grows when your surroundings feel secure.
4.why: The Moon gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 4th, one of its most comfortable placements.

5.title: imagination and a caring mind
5.text: Creative work, study and the company of children tend to bring you joy. Your intelligence is intuitive, and you often sense what others need before they say it. Teaching, the arts and roles that involve guiding young people can suit you well.

6.title: caring through daily service
6.text: You tend to find purpose in looking after others through daily work, routines and practical help. Service-oriented fields such as hospitality, food, caregiving or administration can suit you. Keeping a steady rhythm in your day helps you stay calm and effective under pressure.

7.title: warmth in partnerships
7.text: You tend to relate to others with care and responsiveness, and partnerships matter deeply to you. People often find you easy to work with in business and public dealings. You value emotional understanding and shared comfort, and you bring a nurturing quality into close relationships.
7.why: The Moon in a kendra is traditionally said to give steadiness and public appeal.

8.title: depth and a rich inner life
8.text: You tend to feel things deeply and are drawn to what is hidden, mysterious or private. Research, psychology, shared finances and the study of old traditions can suit your intuitive mind. Times of change often bring fresh understanding, and you value privacy and a few trusted confidants.

9.title: a mind drawn to wisdom
9.text: Faith, philosophy, higher learning and travel to meaningful places tend to nourish you. You often respect teachers and elders and absorb their guidance easily. Your sense of fortune grows when you follow your principles, and teaching or sharing knowledge can come naturally.

10.title: public care and visible work
10.text: Your work often involves the public, and you can adapt quickly to changing demands. Hospitality, public relations, education or anything that serves people's everyday needs can suit you. Your reputation tends to grow through responsiveness, and you may hold several different roles over time.
10.why: The Moon in the 10th, a kendra, is traditionally linked with recognition among the public.

11.title: friends, networks and steady gains
11.text: You tend to have a wide circle of friends and enjoy being part of groups and communities. Gains often come through connections and your feel for what people want. Your hopes and ambitions are often supported by others, especially elders and older siblings.
11.why: The 11th is an upachaya house, where the Moon is classically said to bring the fulfilment of wishes.

12.title: imagination, rest and inner life
12.text: You often need quiet time to recharge, and a rich imagination and dream life can feed creative or spiritual work. Retreats, meditation and generosity bring you peace. Life or work in foreign places, or in quiet settings such as libraries and ashrams, can suit you well.

1.title: energy, drive and initiative
1.text: You tend to approach life with energy, directness and a readiness to act. Physical activity, sport and competitive settings often bring out your best. You are quick to take initiative, and learning when to pause before acting helps your courage work in your favour.

2.title: a forthright voice and drive to earn
2.text: You tend to speak directly and stand up for what you believe. You often work hard to build resources, and family property or land can matter to you. Pairing your frankness with tact helps your words carry real weight in family and at work.

3.title: courage that grows with effort
3.text: Initiative, bravery and a competitive spirit come naturally to you. You often thrive in sport, technical skills, sales, media or any work that calls for decisive action. Siblings and colleagues tend to see you as dependable when something needs to be done quickly.
3.why: The 3rd is an upachaya house, where Mars is traditionally said to grow stronger with time, and Mars is also the karaka of the courage this house signifies.

4.title: energy invested in home and land
4.text: You tend to put real energy into your home, whether building, renovating or improving it. Property, land, vehicles and engineering can interest you. Your restlessness at home often settles once you have a project to pour yourself into or a space you can shape.
4.why: Mars is the traditional karaka of land and property, which the 4th also signifies.

5.title: a quick, competitive mind
5.text: You tend to think quickly and enjoy strategy, debate, sport and games of skill. Study in technical or scientific fields can suit you well. With children and younger people, you often encourage independence and courage, and creative projects benefit from your enthusiasm.

6.title: a strong hand in competition
6.text: You tend to meet competition and challenges head-on, and you rarely shy away from hard work. Law, defence, sport, engineering or any role requiring discipline can suit you. Steady daily routines help you channel your considerable energy productively.
6.why: The 6th is an upachaya house, and Mars here is classically praised for prevailing over rivals and growing stronger with time.

7.title: energy and directness in partnership
7.text: You tend to bring energy, honesty and drive into partnerships, in business and in personal life. You value a partner who shares your goals and can keep pace with you. Working toward shared aims, with each person leading in their own area, tends to bring out the best in both.

8.title: courage in times of change
8.text: You tend to stay decisive when circumstances shift suddenly, and others often turn to you in a crisis. Research, investigation, engineering and work with shared resources or inheritance can suit you. Your ability to dig deep and rebuild after change is a genuine strength.

9.title: conviction and a pioneering spirit
9.text: You tend to hold strong beliefs and act on them with energy. Adventurous travel, debate and championing causes you believe in can suit you. You often learn best through direct experience, and you respect teachers who are as active as they are wise.

10.title: drive and authority in work
10.text: Career tends to be a strong focus, and you work with energy, ambition and a capacity to lead. Engineering, management, administration, real estate or any field needing decisive action can suit you. You often earn respect through results rather than words.
10.why: Mars gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 10th, which is also an upachaya house where it grows stronger with time.

11.title: ambition that brings gains
11.text: You tend to pursue your goals with determination, and gains often come through your own initiative. Your friends and networks can include active, enterprising people. Elder siblings or close associates often play a part in your progress, and your ambitions tend to grow as you achieve them.
11.why: The 11th is an upachaya house, where Mars is traditionally said to grow stronger with time and bring steady gains.

12.title: energy for quiet causes
12.text: You often put your energy into work behind the scenes, in foreign places, or into causes that serve others. Disciplined spiritual practice, such as yoga or long retreats, can suit you. Generous spending on meaningful things and time for rest help you balance your drive.

1.title: a quick and curious mind
1.text: Learning, conversation and wit come easily, and people often notice how readily you explain things. You tend to stay youthful in outlook, adaptable and interested in many subjects. Writing, trade and teaching can all suit you.
1.why: Mercury gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 1st house, so its gifts show readily in your manner.

2.title: a way with words and figures
2.text: Your speech tends to be clear and persuasive, and you can handle accounts, records and family finances carefully. Teaching, writing, sales or any work built on good communication can suit you. Family conversations often turn to learning and ideas.

3.title: a natural writer and messenger
3.text: Writing, media, short trips and lively exchange with siblings and neighbours come naturally. Your skill with hands and words grows through practice, and you often keep several projects moving at once. Courage here shows as quick thinking rather than force.
3.why: The 3rd is an upachaya, a house of growth, so Mercury's skills here tend to sharpen with effort over time.

4.title: learning that begins at home
4.text: Your home is often full of books, conversation and study, and education can be a strong thread in your life. Working from home or dealing in property, vehicles or paperwork may suit you. A busy, thoughtful mind finds peace in familiar surroundings.

5.title: a clever and playful intellect
5.text: Study, puzzles, games of skill and creative writing tend to suit you. You learn quickly and enjoy sharing ideas, and teaching or mentoring younger people can come naturally. Your judgement in planning and strategy is often sharp.

6.title: skill at solving everyday problems
6.text: You tend to bring order to daily routines, schedules and work details, and you enjoy fixing practical problems. Service roles, analysis, accounts and careful negotiation suit you. In friendly competition you often win through preparation and clear argument rather than force.

7.title: partnership built on conversation
7.text: You relate to others through talk, shared interests and mutual curiosity, and you value a partner who is also a friend of the mind. Trade, contracts, agreements and client work can suit you. Your ability to see both sides helps in negotiation.

8.title: a mind drawn to hidden things
8.text: Research, investigation and subjects others find puzzling hold real interest for you. You can be skilled with shared resources, taxes, insurance or inheritance paperwork. Over time your learning tends to go deep rather than wide, and that depth often brings genuine insight.

9.title: a student of wisdom
9.text: Higher study, philosophy, languages and long journeys tend to draw you. You often learn well from teachers and mentors, and you can explain traditional knowledge in a fresh, practical way. Publishing, teaching or academic work can suit you.

10.title: a career that runs on ideas
10.text: Work involving communication, trade, writing, accounts, technology or teaching tends to suit you. You are often known for competence and quick thinking in your profession. Handling several lines of work at once can come naturally to you.

11.title: gains through networks and ideas
11.text: Friends, colleagues and wider networks often bring opportunities, especially through trade, writing or advice. You tend to keep in touch with many people and enjoy exchanging news. Clever planning helps your hopes take practical shape.
11.why: Every graha is traditionally said to do well in the 11th, and Mercury's gift for commerce is especially suited to it.

12.title: a quiet and reflective intellect
12.text: You may think best in solitude, and reading, journaling or study in retreat can be deeply satisfying. Work connected with foreign lands, languages or behind-the-scenes roles can suit you. Your generosity often shows as sharing knowledge freely.

1.title: a wise and generous presence
1.text: People often look to you for guidance, and you tend to carry an optimistic, principled outlook. Learning, teaching and helping others suit you well. Your good faith in others often draws trust and support in return.
1.why: Jupiter gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 1st house, and from a kendra it is traditionally said to strengthen the whole chart.

2.title: wealth of words and family
2.text: Your speech tends to carry weight, and your counsel is often trusted within the family. Resources tend to grow through careful handling and sound values. Teaching, finance or advisory work can suit you, and family traditions often matter to you.
2.why: Jupiter is the natural significator of the 2nd, of wealth and family, so it is comfortable here.

3.title: courage guided by good sense
3.text: You tend to approach effort and initiative with patience and principle rather than haste. Writing, teaching and communication about meaningful subjects can suit you. Siblings and neighbours often benefit from your encouragement and good advice.

4.title: a home of learning and contentment
4.text: Your home life tends to be settled, and education often plays a central part in it. Comfort, property and a sense of inner peace can grow steadily over the years. Your family may value tradition and learning.
4.why: Jupiter in a kendra is traditionally counted a source of steady strength for the chart.

5.title: learning that keeps giving
5.text: Study, teaching and creative work come naturally and tend to bring lasting satisfaction. Your advice is often sought, and your thinking matures well with age. Younger people, at home and beyond, often benefit from your guidance.
5.why: Jupiter is the natural significator of the 5th, of children and wisdom, so it is especially at home here.

6.title: service with a generous spirit
6.text: You tend to handle daily work, routines and responsibilities with patience and fairness. Teaching, counselling, law or service roles can suit you well. In competition you prefer principle to pressure, and colleagues often respect your even-handed approach.

7.title: partnership grounded in respect
7.text: You tend to value wisdom, honesty and shared ideals in close partnerships. Others often find you fair and principled in agreements and dealings. Advisory work, consulting and work with the public can suit you, and your sense of fairness earns respect.
7.why: From the 7th, Jupiter casts its full aspect on the lagna, lending its wisdom to your own outlook.

8.title: depth, research and quiet wisdom
8.text: Research, the study of traditional or hidden subjects and long inquiry tend to draw you. You can manage shared resources, joint finances or inheritance with care and integrity. Times of change often deepen your understanding.

9.title: faith, teachers and higher learning
9.text: Philosophy, higher study, long journeys and respect for teachers tend to run through your life. You often find guidance at the right time and share it generously. Teaching, law, publishing or spiritual study can suit you.
9.why: Jupiter is the natural significator of the 9th, of dharma and teachers, so it is especially at home here.

10.title: a career of trust and counsel
10.text: Work in teaching, consulting, law, finance or administration tends to suit you. People often place trust in your judgement at work, and your reputation tends to rest on integrity. Your career can grow steadily with experience.
10.why: From the 10th, Jupiter aspects the 2nd, 4th and 6th houses, supporting family, home and daily work.

11.title: gains through good company
11.text: Friends, mentors and wider networks often bring opportunities and support. Your hopes tend to be realistic and well grounded, and gains often come through teaching, advice or principled work. You are often generous with your own circle.
11.why: Jupiter is the natural significator of the 11th, of gains, so its gifts here tend to flow readily.

12.title: generosity and a rich inner life
12.text: Charity, spiritual practice, study in quiet places and travel to foreign lands tend to mean a great deal to you. You often give freely, and rest and reflection restore your sense of purpose. Work abroad or in institutions of learning can suit you.

1.title: grace, charm and a love of beauty
1.text: You tend to carry yourself with ease, and people often find you pleasant and approachable. The arts, design, music and refined surroundings attract you. Diplomacy and a sense of balance come naturally in how you meet the world.

2.title: sweet speech and fine tastes
2.text: Your speech tends to be gentle and agreeable, and you often enjoy good food, music and family gatherings. Resources can grow through the arts, beauty or fine goods. You appreciate comfort and tend to create it for others too.

3.title: artistic talent in expression
3.text: Writing, music, performing and design can come naturally, and your communication tends to have charm. Relations with siblings and neighbours are often friendly and warm. Short trips, creative hobbies and time spent on your own craft bring real pleasure.

4.title: a beautiful and comfortable home
4.text: Home, comfort, vehicles and a pleasant domestic atmosphere often matter a great deal to you. You tend to bring beauty into your surroundings and enjoy hosting. Inner contentment comes easily when your home feels harmonious.
4.why: Venus gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 4th house, so its gifts show most readily at home.

5.title: creativity, pleasure and the arts
5.text: Creative work, performance, the arts and enjoyable learning tend to suit you. You often bring warmth and playfulness to friendships and family life, and an appreciation of beauty shapes your choices. Teaching the arts or work in entertainment can be rewarding.

6.title: harmony in daily work
6.text: You tend to bring tact and pleasantness to routines, colleagues and service roles. Work in hospitality, design, fashion or the arts can suit you. In competition you often succeed through diplomacy and charm rather than confrontation.

7.title: partnership, harmony and appreciation
7.text: Close partnerships, friendship and cooperation tend to be central themes, and you value grace and mutual appreciation in how you relate to others. Trade, the arts, diplomacy and client work can suit you. You often bring balance to any shared venture.
7.why: Venus is the natural significator of the 7th, of partnership, so it is closely tied to this house.

8.title: hidden beauty and shared resources
8.text: You may have a talent for managing joint finances, inheritance or investments with good taste and care. Subjects with mystery and depth often fascinate you, and times of change tend to bring renewal. You can find beauty where others overlook it.

9.title: grace in faith and travel
9.text: Long journeys, culture, philosophy and the arts of other traditions tend to attract you. You often have a warm relationship with teachers and mentors and enjoy learning alongside others. Good fortune often arrives through gentleness and generosity of spirit.

10.title: a career in beauty or the arts
10.text: Work in the arts, design, fashion, hospitality, diplomacy or fine goods tends to suit you. You are often well liked at work, and your public image tends to be gracious. Pleasant working relationships help your career move forward.

11.title: gains through friendship and the arts
11.text: Friends, social circles and creative networks often bring opportunities and enjoyment. Your hopes tend to centre on comfort, beauty and good company, and gains can come through the arts or trade. You are often a welcome member of any group.

12.title: pleasures of rest and retreat
12.text: Rest, quiet comforts, travel to foreign lands and private enjoyment of the arts tend to mean a lot to you. You are often generous and enjoy giving gifts. Spiritual practice through music or devotion can be especially fulfilling.
12.why: Venus is traditionally said to be well placed in the 12th, a house of comfort and the pleasures of rest.

1.title: a steady, grounded presence
1.text: You tend to meet the world with patience and a thoughtful, serious manner, and people often come to rely on your steadiness. Confidence can grow slowly and then hold firm. Responsibility, careful work and long commitments suit you well.
1.why: Saturn is traditionally said to mature with age, so its gifts here often show more clearly as the years go by.

2.title: careful with words and money
2.text: You tend to speak with care and handle money thoughtfully, saving steadily rather than spending on impulse. Family duties can matter a great deal to you. Resources built slowly through patience and good habits often last, and your word carries weight.

3.title: effort that compounds over time
3.text: You have staying power in whatever you set out to do, and effort tends to build on itself for you over the years. Writing, skilled work with the hands and steady practice suit you. Siblings and neighbours may find you dependable and serious-minded.
3.why: The 3rd is an upachaya house, where Saturn is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

4.title: building a home that lasts
4.text: You value a stable home and often put real work into making it secure, whether that means property, routine or a quiet place to retreat. Contentment tends to deepen with time. Land, buildings and long-term planning for the household can suit you.

5.title: learning that deepens slowly
5.text: You tend to learn thoroughly rather than quickly, and ideas you take in stay with you. Your creativity is disciplined and practical. Teaching, mentoring and caring for children can bring out your patient, responsible side, and long study suits you.

6.title: steady in daily work
6.text: You handle routine, service and competition with patience, and you tend to outlast others through sheer consistency. Organised daily habits come naturally. Work that involves care, administration or solving practical problems suits you, and colleagues often find you reliable.
6.why: The 6th is an upachaya house, where Saturn is traditionally said to do well and grow stronger with time.

7.title: commitment and mature partnership
7.text: You take partnerships seriously and value loyalty, reliability and shared responsibility. You may be drawn to someone mature, grounded or steady in nature. Contracts and working partnerships suit your careful, fair approach, and the bonds you build tend to deepen with time.
7.why: Classical texts give Saturn directional strength (dig bala) in the 7th house.

8.title: steady and patient through change
8.text: You handle long, slow transitions with more endurance than most, and you like getting to the root of things. Rewards often come later, built on patience. Research, investigation and long-term planning suit you, as do shared resources handled with care.

9.title: wisdom earned through experience
9.text: You tend to respect tradition and form your beliefs through lived experience rather than taking them on trust. Teachers and elders can play a meaningful role in your life. Philosophy, law and long journeys undertaken with purpose suit your thoughtful, principled outlook.

10.title: a career built step by step
10.text: You tend to advance through steady effort, reliability and skill rather than shortcuts, and recognition often grows with the years. Responsibility at work comes naturally. Administration, public service, engineering, management or any field that rewards discipline suits you.
10.why: The 10th is an upachaya house, where Saturn is traditionally said to do well and give results that improve with time.

11.title: gains that grow steadily
11.text: Your gains tend to come through patience, persistence and long-term plans rather than quick wins. Friendships may be few but lasting, often with older or experienced people. Large organisations and community work can suit you well.
11.why: The 11th is an upachaya house, where Saturn is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

12.title: quiet strength in solitude
12.text: You can find real peace in solitude, retreat and quiet reflection, and you often work well behind the scenes. Spending tends to be careful and purposeful. Spiritual practice, charitable work, research institutions and time in foreign lands can suit you.

1.title: drawn to the new
1.text: You tend to meet the world with curiosity and a wish to stand out, and new ideas, places and technologies attract you. Your path may look different from your family's. Your ambition works best when it is paired with steady, honest effort.

2.title: fresh ways with words and resources
2.text: You may speak in a distinctive way, pick up languages or new vocabulary easily, and earn through modern or unusual fields. Your tastes can differ from your family's traditions. Bold ideas about resources, paired with careful money habits, can suit you well.

3.title: bold, curious and full of initiative
3.text: You tend to have plenty of initiative and the courage to try new things, especially in media, writing, technology or travel. Short journeys and new skills keep you energised. Your boldness and curiosity can open doors that others hesitate at.
3.why: The 3rd is an upachaya house, where Rahu is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

4.title: a home open to the world
4.text: You may feel drawn to unusual homes, new places or a life lived away from where you grew up. Modern comforts, vehicles and technology at home can appeal to you. You often find a settled feeling by building a home base that is truly your own.

5.title: inventive and original thinking
5.text: Your thinking tends to be original, and you may be drawn to unusual subjects, technology, research or new ideas. Creative work with a modern edge suits you. Your talents tend to flourish when big ideas meet patient, steady study.

6.title: sharp and resourceful in competition
6.text: You tend to handle competition, rivalry and demanding routines with cleverness and nerve. Problem-solving, technical work and fields that deal with new systems or foreign connections suit you. You can turn demanding daily work into real progress through ingenuity.
6.why: The 6th is an upachaya house, and Rahu is classically said to give some of its best results here.

7.title: partnerships across different worlds
7.text: You may be drawn to partners or associates from different backgrounds, cultures or places, and you value a relationship that feels fresh and expansive. Dealings with the public or overseas can suit you. You tend to bring energy and new perspectives to the partnerships you form.

8.title: curious about what lies hidden
8.text: You are often fascinated by what lies beneath the surface, from research and investigation to psychology and the traditional sciences. Change tends to open new directions for you. Joint finances, research or analytical roles can suit your probing, unconventional mind.

9.title: a seeker of new ideas
9.text: You tend to question inherited beliefs and look for meaning in unfamiliar philosophies, places and teachers. Foreign travel, higher study abroad and learning from other cultures can appeal strongly. Your openness lets you build a worldview that is truly your own.

10.title: big goals in public life
10.text: You tend to have strong ambition for your work and can do well in modern, fast-moving or international fields. Technology, media, public life and large organisations may attract you. Steady ethics and patience give your drive a lasting foundation.
10.why: The 10th is an upachaya house, where Rahu is traditionally said to support ambition and achievement that grow over time.

11.title: wide networks and growing gains
11.text: You tend to build broad networks, often including people from different backgrounds or countries. Gains can come through technology, new ventures or large groups. Your big hopes are often matched by the drive to pursue them steadily.
11.why: Rahu is classically said to do especially well in the 11th, an upachaya house, where its results improve with time.

12.title: far horizons and inner journeys
12.text: You may feel drawn to foreign lands, distant places and work that happens behind the scenes or across borders. Meditation, spiritual practice and quiet retreat can fascinate you. Generosity and thoughtful, purposeful spending can sit together well for you.

1.title: a quiet, inward kind of self-awareness
1.text: You tend to carry a calm, self-contained manner and often see past surface appearances. You may not seek attention, yet people sense your depth. Intuition, spiritual interests and an independent way of living can come naturally to you.

2.title: few words, deeply meant
2.text: You tend to speak simply and directly, with few words, each one meant. Material possessions may matter less to you than inner contentment. You hold family ties with a quiet, independent warmth, and you value what is genuine over what is showy.

3.title: courage without any fuss
3.text: You can act bravely and independently without needing praise, and you often follow your own instincts. Writing, research or skilled hands-on work done quietly can suit you. You may value deep conversations over constant contact with others.
3.why: The 3rd is an upachaya house, where Ketu is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

4.title: inner peace over outer comforts
4.text: You may find your sense of home more within yourself than in any particular place or possession. Simple surroundings and quiet spaces often suit you. A rich inner life, spiritual reading or reflection can give you a deep feeling of belonging.

5.title: an intuitive and original mind
5.text: Your intelligence tends to work through intuition and sudden insight rather than rote learning. Mathematics, philosophy, research or spiritual study may attract you. You can bring a calm, unattached perspective to creative work and to guiding younger people.

6.title: calm and steady under pressure
6.text: You tend to handle competition and daily demands with calm detachment, not taking rivalry too personally. Service, research and technical problem-solving can suit you. You can work steadily without needing recognition, which often earns you quiet respect.
6.why: The 6th is an upachaya house, where Ketu is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

7.title: independence within a close partnership
7.text: You value space and individuality in close relationships, and you tend to connect with others at a deep, unspoken level. A partner with spiritual or unusual interests may appeal to you. Mutual respect for each other's independence often makes your partnerships feel genuine.

8.title: deep insight and intuition
8.text: You have a natural pull toward the hidden side of life, from research and investigation to astrology, psychology and spiritual study. Change tends to deepen your understanding. You can sense what lies beneath the surface, and that insight is a real strength.

9.title: a personal, lived faith
9.text: You tend to find your own path in belief and philosophy rather than following set rules. Quiet pilgrimage, independent study and reflection can mean a great deal to you. Your understanding of meaning often comes from direct experience and inner conviction.

10.title: work done for its own sake
10.text: You tend to work with focus and skill with no need for status or applause. Technical, research, spiritual or specialised fields can suit you, where depth matters more than display. You may change direction in your career when a path stops feeling meaningful.
10.why: The 10th is an upachaya house, where Ketu is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

11.title: contentment with what matters
11.text: You tend to value a few meaningful friendships over a large circle, and your goals are often more inward than material. Gains can come in quiet, unexpected ways. You can let go of ambitions that no longer fit, which keeps your life clear and focused.
11.why: The 11th is an upachaya house, where Ketu is traditionally said to do well and improve with time.

12.title: inner freedom and spiritual depth
12.text: You may feel a natural pull toward meditation, retreat and spiritual life, and solitude often refreshes you. Letting go of what is unnecessary tends to come easily. Time in foreign lands, quiet places or charitable work can bring you deep peace.
12.why: Ketu in the 12th is classically considered favourable for spiritual life and inner freedom (moksha).

ui.note: These are traditional notes from Vedic astrology, for reflection and cultural interest. They are not predictions of events and not advice. For important decisions, rely on your own judgement and qualified professionals.
ui.exaltedWhy: {graha} is in {sign}, its sign of exaltation, {clause}.
ui.lagnaWhy: {sign} is the lagna, the sign rising at birth. It is {signNature}, ruled by {lordRole}.
ui.lagnaWhyShort: {sign} rose at birth; its lord is {lord}.
ui.noTimeTitle: Add the birth time for the lagna
ui.noTimeText: The lagna, the sign rising at birth, needs the time of birth. Until then the houses are counted from the Moon's sign.
ui.moonWhy: The Moon shows the mind and emotions. {sign} is {signNature}. {star} is ruled by {starLord} and is traditionally linked with {starPhrase}.
ui.moonWhyShort: The Moon shows the mind; {sign} is {signNature}.
ui.lordWhy: {lordRole}, rules your lagna, {sign}, and sits in {houseRole}. Where the lagna's lord goes, the focus of life tends to follow.
ui.lordWhyMoon: {lordRole}, rules {sign}, the Moon's sign, and sits in {houseRole}, counted from the Moon.
ui.dashaWhy: {graha} rules the mahadasha from {from} to {to}. In this chart {graha} sits in {houseRole}.
ui.dashaWhyShort: {graha} rules this period and sits in your {house}.
ui.antarWhy: The {antar} antardasha runs until {until}. In this chart {antar} sits in {houseRole}.
ui.nextWhy: The {antar} antardasha begins in {from}. In this chart {antar} sits in {houseRole}.
ui.strongWhy: {graha} has the highest Shadbala in this chart, measured against its customary minimum.

yogaWhy.gajakesari: Jupiter is in a kendra (the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house) from the Moon.
yogaWhy.budhaditya: The Sun and Mercury sit together in the same sign.
yogaWhy.chandra-mangala: The Moon and Mars sit together in the same sign.
yogaWhy.sunapha: {grahas} in the 2nd house from the Moon.
yogaWhy.anapha: {grahas} in the 12th house from the Moon.
yogaWhy.durudhara: {grahas} on both sides of the Moon, in the 2nd and 12th houses from it.
yogaWhy.vesi: {grahas} in the 2nd house from the Sun.
yogaWhy.vasi: {grahas} in the 12th house from the Sun.
yogaWhy.ubhayachari: {grahas} on both sides of the Sun, in the 2nd and 12th houses from it.
yogaWhy.amala: {grahas} in the 10th house, a natural benefic in the house of work.
yogaWhy.parivartana: {a} and {b} each sit in the other's sign, an exchange that links their houses.
yogaWhy.ruchaka: Mars is in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra from the lagna.
yogaWhy.bhadra: Mercury is in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra from the lagna.
yogaWhy.hamsa: Jupiter is in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra from the lagna.
yogaWhy.malavya: Venus is in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra from the lagna.
yogaWhy.sasa: Saturn is in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra from the lagna.

intros.time: The Vimshottari dasha running now, its sub-period, and what comes next.
intros.today: Today's Moon and tara, counted from your Moon sign and birth star.
intros.week: Mercury and Venus this week, counted from your Moon sign.
intros.month: The Sun and Mars this month, counted from your Moon sign.
intros.year: Jupiter and Saturn this year, counted from your Moon sign.
intros.more: The grahas in your 2nd, 6th, 8th and 11th houses.
intros.past: What tradition reads, from Ketu's place, about what the soul carries in.
intros.property: Home, land and vehicles: read from the lord of your 4th house and the grahas in it.
intros.parents: Your mother, read from the lord of the 4th; your father, from the lord of the 9th and the grahas in it.
intros.marriage: Partnership, read from the lord of the 7th; children, from the lord of the 5th; with the grahas in both houses.
intros.career: Your work, read from the lord of the 10th; going abroad, from the lord of the 12th; with the grahas in both houses.

ui.transitWhy: {graha} is passing through {sign}, the {house} counted from your Moon sign, {moonSign}.
ui.taraWhy: Today's Moon is in {today}; counted from your birth star, {star}, it gives this tara.
ui.topicWhy: {lordRole}, rules your {n} house, {sign}, and sits in {houseRole}.
ui.pastWhy: Ketu, the south node, sits in {houseRole}. Tradition reads Ketu's house as what the soul carries in from before.
ui.disclaimer: These are traditional notes from Vedic astrology, for reflection and cultural interest. They are not predictions of events and not advice. For important decisions, rely on your own judgement and qualified professionals.

sun.title: purpose and authority at full strength
sun.text: This is the Sun's mahadasha at its most concentrated, and confidence, leadership and a clear sense of direction tend to come to the front. It often suits taking charge of a role, speaking up for your ideas and earning recognition from senior figures. Your father or mentors can play a meaningful part, and decisions made now tend to reflect who you really are.

moon.title: leadership softened by care for home
moon.text: Within the Sun's period, the Moon's sub-period tends to turn attention from public standing toward home, family and feeling. It often suits balancing work ambitions with time for the people closest to you, and caring for a parent or settling a household can feature. Public-facing work, travel and a warmer, more approachable way of leading are also common themes.

mars.title: bold initiative backed by conviction
mars.text: Mars brings energy and courage into the Sun's period, so this sub-period often suits acting on plans you have been weighing for a while. Taking the lead on a project, handling property or technical matters, and standing firm in competitive settings can come naturally. Siblings and close colleagues can be active partners, and steady focus keeps the extra drive productive.

mercury.title: clear words that earn respect
mercury.text: Mercury's sub-period within the Sun's mahadasha tends to bring writing, analysis, negotiation and trade into focus. It often suits presenting your ideas to people in authority, studying for a qualification, or using clear communication to strengthen your position at work. Contracts, paperwork and useful contacts can multiply, and a sharp, organised mind serves your ambitions well.

jupiter.title: recognition joined with wisdom and guidance
jupiter.text: Jupiter's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha is traditionally one of the warmest combinations, joining authority with wisdom. It often suits teaching, advising, higher study or a role where people look to you for sound judgment. Guidance from teachers or elders, meaningful family occasions and a growing sense of purpose can all feature, along with generosity that comes back in kind.

venus.title: standing and refinement in partnership
venus.text: Venus brings comfort, beauty and partnership into the Sun's period. This sub-period often suits creative work done with confidence, improving your home or surroundings, and enjoying the rewards of earlier effort. Working relationships and close partnerships can call for a balance between leading and sharing, and handling money with care helps you enjoy what you have built.

saturn.title: authority built through patient duty
saturn.text: Saturn's sub-period within the Sun's mahadasha tends to ask for patience and responsibility alongside ambition. It often suits taking on serious commitments at work, building structures that last and earning respect through reliability rather than display. Duties toward older family members or long-standing institutions can feature, and quiet, disciplined effort now tends to strengthen your standing for years to come.

rahu.title: ambition reaching toward new ground
rahu.text: Rahu's sub-period amplifies the Sun's drive for recognition and points it toward the unfamiliar. It often brings openings in new fields, technology, travel or work with people from other cultures. Big ambitions can feel close at hand, and grounding them in your own values helps turn bold moves into lasting progress. Curiosity about unconventional paths is a real strength now.

ketu.title: looking inward behind the public role
ketu.text: Ketu's sub-period within the Sun's mahadasha tends to draw attention from outward status toward inner purpose. It often suits reflection, research, spiritual study and quietly refining your skills rather than seeking the spotlight. Letting go of roles or ambitions that no longer fit can feel freeing, and the clarity gained now often shapes the next chapter of your work.

moon.title: home and feeling at their heart
moon.text: This is the Moon's mahadasha at its most concentrated, so home, family, feelings and care for others tend to sit at the centre of life. It often suits settling a household, spending time with your mother or family elders, and nurturing close bonds. Public-facing work, travel near water and a deeper sense of inner contentment can also be strong themes.

mars.title: feeling turned into practical action
mars.text: Mars brings energy and initiative into the Moon's gentle period. This sub-period often suits acting on family plans, buying, building or improving property, and defending what matters to you with courage. Feelings can run strong, and channelling them into purposeful work brings the best results. Traditionally this pairing is also linked with gains through enterprise and steady effort.

rahu.title: restless curiosity and wider horizons
rahu.text: Rahu's sub-period within the Moon's mahadasha tends to stir the mind with new interests and a wish to explore. It often brings travel, a change of residence, contact with other cultures or fresh ideas about how you want to live. Imagination runs high, and grounding routines at home help turn that restless curiosity into meaningful new directions.

jupiter.title: contentment, learning and family blessings
jupiter.text: Jupiter's sub-period in the Moon's mahadasha joins feeling with wisdom, and tradition treats it as a generous combination. It often suits study, teaching, spiritual reading and meaningful family occasions. Children, teachers and advisers can bring joy and guidance, and a calm, hopeful outlook tends to grow. Generosity toward others often comes back as goodwill and support.

saturn.title: steady care and quiet responsibility
saturn.text: Saturn's sub-period within the Moon's mahadasha tends to bring duty and patience into home and emotional life. It often suits caring for family elders, organising household matters for the long term and taking feelings seriously without rushing them. Work can call for persistence, and the emotional steadiness you build now tends to become a lasting inner resource.

mercury.title: a lively mind and easy conversation
mercury.text: Mercury's sub-period brings learning, talk and trade into the Moon's period. It often suits study, writing, short journeys and business that depends on people and good communication. Friendships and conversations with younger relatives can be lively, and you may find it easier to put feelings into words. A light, curious mood tends to make this a productive and sociable time.

ketu.title: quiet reflection and gentle letting go
ketu.text: Ketu's sub-period within the Moon's mahadasha tends to turn feelings inward. It often suits meditation, pilgrimage, quiet study and stepping back from busy social life to understand what truly nourishes you. Old attachments that no longer serve can be released gently, and an intuitive, peaceful inner life tends to deepen. Simplicity at home can feel especially restful now.

venus.title: comfort, beauty and warm companionship
venus.text: Venus brings comfort, beauty and partnership into the Moon's mahadasha, a soft and pleasant combination. This sub-period often suits enjoying home life, decorating or improving your surroundings, music, the arts and time with people you love. Close partnerships can feel warm and appreciative, and careful spending lets you enjoy small luxuries without strain on your resources.

sun.title: feelings meet a clearer purpose
sun.text: The Sun's sub-period within the Moon's mahadasha tends to add confidence and direction to a period centred on home and feeling. It often suits stepping into a visible role, dealing with officials or senior people, and taking responsibility for family matters. Your father or a mentor can be significant, and a balance between pride and tenderness serves you well.

mars.title: drive and courage at their peak
mars.text: This is the mahadasha of Mars at its most concentrated, so energy, courage and the wish to act tend to be strong. It often suits launching projects, physical training, sport, technical or engineering work, and property matters. Siblings and teammates can be important. Channelling this drive toward clear goals, and pausing before quick reactions, helps the extra energy build real results.

rahu.title: bold ventures into the unfamiliar
rahu.text: Rahu's sub-period within the mahadasha of Mars tends to combine drive with large ambitions and unusual paths. It often brings work with technology, new industries, travel or people from different backgrounds. Bold moves can come quickly, and pairing them with careful research and clear plans helps you make the most of them. Independent, pioneering work suits this time.

jupiter.title: energy guided by good judgment
jupiter.text: Jupiter's sub-period brings wisdom and growth into the active mahadasha of Mars. It often suits putting energy behind meaningful causes, teaching or coaching, higher study and decisions guided by principle. Property, family matters and children can be happy themes, and advice from teachers or elders tends to be valuable. Courage balanced with generosity makes this a constructive time.

saturn.title: determined effort over the long haul
saturn.text: Saturn's sub-period within the mahadasha of Mars tends to slow quick action into patient, determined effort. It often suits demanding work, construction, technical projects and anything that needs persistence over months rather than days. Plans can take longer to show results, and steady discipline turns that into strength. Responsibility shouldered now tends to build lasting competence and respect.

mercury.title: sharp skills put to work
mercury.text: Mercury's sub-period brings analysis, speech and skill into the mahadasha of Mars. It often suits technical study, debate, negotiation, writing with conviction and business that rewards quick thinking. Contracts and practical problem-solving can go well, and colleagues or siblings may be active partners. Keeping words measured helps your energy persuade rather than provoke, and sharp skills tend to pay off.

ketu.title: focused energy and precise work
ketu.text: Ketu's sub-period within the mahadasha of Mars tends to turn energy toward focus and precision. It often suits research, martial arts or yoga, technical mastery and working quietly on your own. Some ambitions can lose their pull, and letting them go frees your effort for what really matters. Inner discipline and a sharp, intuitive sense of timing are real strengths now.

venus.title: passion, creativity and pleasant gains
venus.text: Venus brings beauty, comfort and partnership into the energetic mahadasha of Mars. This sub-period often suits creative work with drive behind it, design, buying or improving a home or vehicle, and enjoying social life. Close partnerships can feel lively and warm, and balancing your own wishes with a partner's tends to keep things harmonious. Money is best handled with care.

sun.title: leadership and decisive public action
sun.text: The Sun's sub-period within the mahadasha of Mars joins courage with authority. It often suits taking a leading role, dealing with government or senior people, and acting decisively on matters of principle. Recognition can come through bold, visible effort. Your father or a mentor may be significant, and confidence used with fairness helps you earn lasting respect.

moon.title: drive balanced by home and heart
moon.text: The Moon's sub-period brings feeling, home and care into the mahadasha of Mars. It often suits property and household projects, looking after family, and work that involves the public. Feelings can run strong, and giving them a calm outlet helps. Tradition links this pairing with gains through enterprise, and caring energy put into the people around you is well spent.

rahu.title: ambition and exploration at full volume
rahu.text: This is Rahu's mahadasha at its most concentrated, so ambition, curiosity and the pull toward the new tend to be at their strongest. It often brings unfamiliar fields, technology, travel and people from other cultures into daily life. Large goals can feel within reach, and staying anchored in your own values helps turn rapid change into solid, lasting achievement.

jupiter.title: big ambitions given wise direction
jupiter.text: Jupiter's sub-period within Rahu's mahadasha tends to bring wisdom and good counsel to large ambitions. It often suits higher study, international learning, teaching and finding mentors who help you see clearly. Ethical choices and generosity tend to steady the fast pace of Rahu's period, and family occasions or children can bring meaning. Growth now often has a solid foundation.

saturn.title: turning big plans into structure
saturn.text: Saturn's sub-period within Rahu's mahadasha tends to ask for patience and structure behind ambitious plans. It often suits long-term projects, work in large organisations or with technology, and taking on serious responsibilities. Results can build slowly, and persistence turns that into lasting strength. Practical discipline now helps convert bold ideas into something reliable and enduring.

mercury.title: clever ideas and new connections
mercury.text: Mercury's sub-period within Rahu's mahadasha tends to sharpen curiosity and quick thinking. It often suits technology, media, trade, research and learning new languages or skills. Networks can widen fast, bringing unusual contacts and ideas. Checking facts and reading contracts carefully helps you make the most of the many openings this lively, inventive time can bring.

ketu.title: ambition meets its quiet counterweight
ketu.text: Ketu's sub-period within Rahu's mahadasha brings the two nodes together, joining outward ambition with inner reflection.
